data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'qabala' which means 'to take, to receive'. Muqbalah refers to someone who is desirable, loved, and cherished. This name holds a special significance in Islamic culture as it is mentioned in the Quran (26:83). The name Muqbalah carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
